example_limits: Original pure sequential carrier-a schema-1 to warehouse schema-2 parcel projection. Input is an already-decoded exact six-field dictionary with integer schema 1, source carrier-a, ASCII identifiers of 1..64 allowed characters, documented R/D states, and a bounded decimal kilogram string. Local Decimal precision 20 converts exactly to 1..50000 integer grams; fractional grams, invalid/range/shape/version/source/code values raise TranslationError before target construction. Source namespace, event and parcel identities, target schema, and mapping version are preserved explicitly; source input is unchanged. Gross mass must have the same meaning on both sides by agreement. No authentication, input parser/size controls, network, broker, enqueue acknowledgment, persistent quarantine, enrichment, deduplication, timers, synchronization, or reverse byte reconstruction. Caller owns error retention and delivery. A mapping version aids investigation but does not pin replay rules. Camel is an explanatory implementation context only.
